description: Correct a card of a detection to the right catalog card. Free, within 24 hours of the detection, 3 times per card, only for the API key that made the detection. card_id comes from a correction search result or from the detected card's alternatives. Returns the full corrected card. Corrections also improve the recognition. Yu-Gi-Oh!: card_id is the passcode, set the printed code (LOB-EN001) to pick a printing. Magic: card_id is the oracle_id with set + number for the printing. One Piece: cardmarket_id picks a parallel. Pokémon: cardmarket_id of one of the card's possible_variants picks that special version (its price comes back), reverse_holo says whether the copy is a reverse holo. Digimon: card_id is a printing id (dg-BT1-025_P1, dg-ja-BT1-025_P1) or dg-c-<number> while the printing is open. Cyberpunk: card_id is a printing id (cp-WNC-132, the Beta cp-WNCB-132, French cp-fr-WNC-132) or cp-c-<card_key> while the printing is open. Riftbound detections cannot be corrected (detection only): pick a printing from the card's alternatives yourself.

card_id.description: card_id of a search result or an alternative.

card_index.description: cards[].card_index of the card to correct.

cardmarket_id.description: One Piece: picks a parallel printing. Pokémon: a possible_variants cardmarket_id of that card picks the special version (any other id: 400 unsupported_cardmarket_id).

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game; Digimon en or ja; Cyberpunk en or fr). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football and basketball.

number.description: Magic, SWU: collector number of the printing.

reverse_holo.description: Pokémon only: the copy is (true) or is not (false) a reverse holo. Default: as detected.

set.description: Magic, SWU: set of the printing; Yu-Gi-Oh!: the printed code.

name: correct_card
title: Correct a detected card
